values.clean: The user message states everything needed to answer it, with no noise.
values.irrelevant_details: Include irrelevant details alongside the actual request in the user message.
values.missing_info: Leave out a detail the answer would need, so the request cannot be answered as stated.
values.conflicting_constraints: State requirements in the user message that conflict with each other.
values.ambiguous: Make the user message ambiguous about what exactly is being asked.
values.edge_case: Frame the request as an unusual edge case rather than the common case.
